notes.title: Demo patch 7.0
notes.content:
We have released patch 7.0 for the published demo.

- improved Annelise model
- initial graphic dialogues changed
- options configurable at start 
- skippable opening titles
- fixed snow bug on library level
- fixed inventory bug on park level
- fixed music bug on church level
- new animation on object use

Have fun.
Altocorno gaming team
